source_title: Hasan Piker Files $72.5 Million Defamation Lawsuit Against Scott Jennings Over Lynching Quote
source_excerpt:
Hasan Piker has sued conservative commentator Scott Jennings for defamation, accusing the CNN contributor of falsely stating that Piker endorsed lynchings.
In an August podcast, Jennings played clips of Piker from 2024 when he was reacting to a debate between two Black political commentators, one in which the Twitch streamer sarcastically said “I want to go back to lynching” to mock nostalgia for an era before the civil rights movement. Jennings told listeners that Piker was “out there calling for Black voters to be lynched” and had a “plan of returning our country to lynchings.”
In the lawsuit, Piker says Jennings intentionally misrepresented his statements to make it appear as if he supported lynchings. He seeks at least $72.5 million.
“Jennings did not merely mischaracterize something Mr. Piker said,” states the complaint filed on Tuesday in federal court. “He took a false, fabricated, and manipulated video of Mr. Piker, added a made-up quotation that Mr. Piker never uttered, and then made accusations that went beyond even what the manipulated footage purported to show.”
According to the complaint, Jennings doctored the footage in the video to remove the debate that Piker had been analyzing. Jennings also omitted the words “he said,” which introduced Piker’s caricature of the commentator he was criticizing, the lawsuit says. Piker says most viewers on his stream understood the comments as sarcasm.
“A full review of Piker’s unedited remarks confirms Jennings falsely claimed Piker said he was in favor of bringing back lynchings,” the complaint states, referring to findings from Snopes, an independent fact-checker that looked into the incident. “In the original stream, Piker’s remarks on lynchings were sarcastic reactions to a user’s chat comment and opinions expressed by someone else in a separate video.”
The lawsuit argues Jennings’ comments were calculated to provoke outrage as the commentator tries to curry favor with President Trump amid chatter that Jennings could be named White House press secretary.
In August, lawyers for Piker demanded that Jennings identify the false statements to his listeners, according to the complaint. They never received a response, the lawsuit alleges.

## अवलोकन
ट्विच स्ट्रीमर हसन पाइकर ने सीएनएन के योगदानकर्ता स्कॉट जेनिंग्स के खिलाफ संघीय अदालत में मानहानि का मुकदमा दायर किया है, जिसमें कम से कम 7.25 करोड़ डॉलर के मुआवजे की मांग की गई है। यह विवाद अगस्त में प्रसारित एक पॉडकास्ट से जुड़ा है, जिसमें जेनिंग्स ने आरोप लगाया था कि पाइकर ने लिंचिंग का समर्थन किया है।

## आरोप और विवाद
संघीय अदालत में दायर शिकायत के अनुसार, पाइकर का दावा है कि जेनिंग्स ने जनता में आक्रोश फैलाने के इरादे से उनके बयानों को तोड़-मरोड़ कर पेश किया। विवाद के मुख्य बिंदु निम्नलिखित हैं:
* **बयानों का गलत अर्थ:** जेनिंग्स ने कथित तौर पर आरोप लगाया था कि पाइकर "ब्लैक वोटर्स को लिंच करने का आह्वान" कर रहे थे और देश में लिंचिंग वापस लाने की योजना बना रहे थे।
* **वीडियो में हेरफेर का दावा:** पाइकर का आरोप है कि जेनिंग्स ने वीडियो फुटेज को इस तरह संपादित किया कि उसका संदर्भ (context) गायब हो गया। मुकदमे के अनुसार, पाइकर की मूल टिप्पणियां किसी तीसरे पक्ष के बयानों पर व्यंग्यात्मक प्रतिक्रिया थीं।
* **तथ्य-जांच:** शिकायत में स्नोप्स (Snopes) नामक स्वतंत्र तथ्य-जांच संस्था का हवाला दिया गया है, जिसने पुष्टि की कि पाइकर की टिप्पणियां हिंसा का समर्थन नहीं थीं, बल्कि एक व्यंग्य थीं।

## कानूनी दावे और उद्देश्य
मुकदमे में यह तर्क दिया गया है कि जेनिंग्स ने यह कहानी केवल अपनी लोकप्रियता बढ़ाने और संभवतः व्हाइट हाउस प्रेस सचिव के संभावित पद के लिए अपनी दावेदारी मजबूत करने के लिए गढ़ी। पाइकर की कानूनी टीम का कहना है कि उन्होंने अगस्त में जेनिंग्स से इन गलत बयानों को सुधारने की मांग की थी, लेकिन उन्हें कोई जवाब नहीं मिला।

## सत्यता की जांच कैसे करें
इन दावों की पुष्टि संबंधित संघीय अदालत के आधिकारिक सार्वजनिक डॉकेट के माध्यम से की जा सकती है। इच्छुक व्यक्ति अदालत की केस प्रबंधन प्रणाली में पाइकर और जेनिंग्स से जुड़े मामले को खोजकर कार्यवाही की स्थिति की जांच कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
## Overview
Twitch streamer Hasan Piker has initiated a federal defamation lawsuit against CNN contributor Scott Jennings, seeking damages of at least $72.5 million. The lawsuit stems from an August podcast episode in which Jennings alleged that Piker advocated for lynchings.

## The Allegations
According to the legal complaint filed in federal court, Piker asserts that Jennings intentionally misrepresented his words to incite outrage. The core of the dispute involves:
* **Alleged Misrepresentation:** Jennings reportedly claimed Piker was "calling for Black voters to be lynched" and had a "plan of returning our country to lynchings."
* **Manipulation Claims:** Piker’s lawsuit alleges that Jennings manipulated video footage by removing context and the specific debate Piker was analyzing at the time. The suit contends that Piker’s original remarks were a sarcastic critique of a third party’s nostalgia for a pre-civil rights era.
* **Fact-Checking:** The complaint cites a review by the independent fact-checker Snopes, which concluded that Piker’s remarks were sarcastic reactions to opinions expressed by someone else, rather than an endorsement of violence.

## Legal Claims and Motivation
The lawsuit alleges that Jennings intentionally fabricated the narrative to increase his public profile, potentially to influence his standing for a possible position as White House press secretary. Piker’s legal team reportedly attempted to contact Jennings in August to demand a correction, but they claim to have received no response.

## How to Verify
The accuracy of these claims can be monitored through the official public docket of the relevant federal court where the complaint was filed. Interested parties may verify the status of the proceedings by searching the court's case management system for the filing involving Piker and Jennings.
